chunks.title: Docker Security Baseline Reminders
chunks.content:
Docker Security Baseline Reminders

Core security reminders applied during Docker artifact generation: prefer minimal base images (alpine, distroless, slim), avoid embedding secrets in image layers or ENV instructions, expose only ports required by the service, use a non-root USER when the application supports it.

Decision rules:
- Always prefer minimal base images: python:3.11-slim, node:20-alpine, eclipse-temurin:17-jre-alpine, or distroless variants
- Never embed secrets via ENV or hardcoded ARG instructions — pass at runtime
- Expose only the service port — do not expose debug or admin ports
- Add USER appuser before CMD/ENTRYPOINT whenever the application does not require root

Anti-patterns:
- Using full OS images (ubuntu:latest, debian:latest) as base instead of slim/distroless
- Setting ENV API_KEY=sk-secret123 or similar in Dockerfile
- Running containers as root (UID 0) in production
